title: Use local pgvector before bulk object generation
problem: Generated JSONL shards can grow without a queryable canonical store.
recommended_pattern: Start a local pgvector-backed Postgres with Docker Compose, initialize the canonical schema, apply deterministic loader SQL, and run the object-count SQL before claiming database-backed scale.
quality_gate: The run publishes separate manifest_count, staged_jsonl_row_count, and canonical_db_row_count.

title: Use the same schema/load/count sequence for managed Postgres
problem: Render, Supabase, Neon, Railway, and other providers differ operationally, but the object-factory database contract should not drift.
recommended_pattern: Require pgvector support, then run schema.sql, factory loader SQL, and object_count_report.sql against the managed DATABASE_URL.
quality_gate: Managed deployment readiness requires successful CREATE EXTENSION vector or an explicitly documented alternate vector backend.

title: Keep YAML curated and store high-volume rows in Postgres
problem: Inflating manifests to hit million-object scale slows validation and hides curator intent.
recommended_pattern: Store generated candidates, labels, dimensions, embeddings, and index records in Postgres. Promote only reviewed, reusable, high-value objects into catalog manifests.
quality_gate: A promoted manifest references source provenance, a review ticket, or a promotion decision.
